title: Radioactive Zombie Panda Biker
description: A grotesque zombie panda with exposed skull face, glowing green eyes and dripping toxic green ooze rides a flaming motorcycle across a cracked wasteland. The bear wears a spiked collar, has purple fur with heart and star patches, holds a cluster of glowing radioactive green bears in one paw, while purple and yellow flames engulf the bike which features a skull headlight and radiation symbol on the wheel.
prompt: A horrifying zombie panda with half its skull exposed, glowing neon green eyes and mouth dripping toxic green slime, wearing a purple fur jacket with hearts and stars, rides a flaming motorcycle with skull headlight and radiation symbol on the wheel. The bear holds a cluster of small glowing radioactive teddy bears that are melting. The scene is set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland with bubbling green pools, skeletons, and water towers under a toxic purple and yellow sky with green lightning.
